what: The Frobenius-orbit canonicalisation priced on its own, and the bucket skew the canonical key causes, measured on the real table
relationship_to_other_runs: Supporting measurements for the normal-basis key and the bucket-index fix that koblitz-orbit-fold-20260913.json records end to end. Those two ran on a different host; nothing here should be combined with them into a single figure.

what_it_settles: The 8.6x is against this repository's own reducer - a bit-spread and eight table lookups - not against a slow one.

Interleaving buys the rotation nothing: the n-1 rotations are formed from the coordinate word directly and share no dependency chain. That is why the lookup path no longer keeps eight canonicalisations in flight.
Reducing the squaring by shifts instead of by table, which the trinomial at this degree permits, is worse than the table it replaces.

bucket_skew.why_it_happens: A canonical key is a minimum over n rotations, so it sits far below the middle of its range and its high bits are not uniform. Indexing buckets by those bits piles the table into a low slice of the index.
bucket_skew.measured_on: the real folded table at n = 61, 258632192 entries over 2^24 buckets

the_benchmark_that_missed_it.what_was_measured: 200000 probes of the folded table, of which 20 hit; fixing the bucket index moved that number 362.7 -> 359.8 ns.
the_benchmark_that_missed_it.why_that_is_2.9_ns_and_not_a_refutation: The presence filter is four bits an entry, 2^30 bits at this width, 11.3% occupancy - so seven probes in eight never reach a bucket, and the one that does reads a contiguous run of u32 the prefetcher handles, about four cache lines a probe amortised whatever the run length. The cost is on hits, which this stream had twenty of. A benchmark of misses would have certified the bug as absent.
the_benchmark_that_missed_it.the_correction: koblitz-orbit-fold-20260913.json and the RESEARCH note carry the hit-path measurement, which is where the fix is worth its 374 -> 285 ns and more.

not_claimed: That these numbers combine with the end-to-end run. Different host, and the end-to-end run also carries the orbit tag and the row filter.
That an optimal normal basis is involved. Every F_2^n has a normal basis and the rotation property holds in all of them; optimality is about multiplication, which this never does.
